title: Store and retrieve
summary: Run a stacker crane from a chart: store each box in the first free cell and bring a box back when its request button is pressed.
scope: Passing means your program behaved correctly in the simulator on this computer. It says nothing about a real machine, its timing or its safety.
objectives: Write the store and the retrieve sequences of a crane as chains of steps.
Keep a table of occupied cells and the requests that wait, and choose the next job from them.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/Warehouse.sfc.json the crane already stores every box that reaches the infeed, but a press of a request button does nothing. Make the crane serve a request: take the box out of the requested cell, bring it to the dock and put it on the outfeed belt.
stages.checkpoint: You can say what makes the crane store a box, what makes it retrieve one, and what it does with a request pressed while it is busy.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, follow one box from the infeed to its cell, and from its cell to the outfeed when its request button is pressed. At each end of the journey, predict where the crane stands and what its fork does.
stages.checkpoint: The crane holds still while its fork is out, and Green lights after two boxes have been put on the outfeed.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Write the missing behaviour, save it, then press {{ui:learn.check}}. The starting project stores boxes, but a request is never served: the box stays in its cell, no box reaches the outfeed bin and Green never lights. When a request waits for a cell that holds a box, the crane must fetch that box and put it on the outfeed belt.
stages.checkpoint: Check reports the scenario of this lesson as passed.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: Press Check. ZPLC runs your saved program against the scenario of this lesson, with the plant answering your outputs, and lists every assertion that failed. To watch the plant move, press Run (F5) and open the 3D view.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named stacker-crane-warehouse and contains {{assertions}} assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Watch the fork in the 3D view and read stored: and blocked: in the facts text; blocked stays at zero.
stages.checkpoint: stored counts the boxes at rest in the rack, and blocked stays at zero because the crane never moves with the fork out.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: The EVENTUALLY assertions prove that cells 1 and 2 held a box and that a box reached the outfeed bin; the ALWAYS assertion proves no move was refused and nothing fell.
stages.checkpoint: The grade cannot see which cell a box left from, nor the order of the jobs; it sees the cells, the bin and Green.

hints.text: Look at how the store chain chooses the cell it goes to, and at what the crane remembers about the cells and the requests. A retrieve needs the same kind of choice, from the cells that hold a box and the requests that wait.

Choose the cell in a P1 action, which runs once when the step is entered: the first cell with its Want and Held both TRUE; Bay and Level can be set in the same action and they keep their value. Add the retrieve chain and start it from IDLE with a transition of priority 2, after the store transition, when (Want1 AND Held1) OR (Want2 AND Held2) OR (Want3 AND Held3). Wait for the step time of 0.3 s and for InPos before extending the fork, and change Bay or Level only in a step where the fork is retracted. Give every step its own action that writes every crane output, and A_COMMON: ForkLeft and RunIn are FALSE in every step of the chain; Raise is TRUE from R_RAISE to R_BACK; ForkRight is TRUE in R_FORK_OUT, R_RAISE, R_LIFTED, R_DOCK_OUT, R_UNLOAD and R_CLEAR; BeltRight is TRUE in R_UNLOAD and R_CLEAR; every other BOOL output of the crane is FALSE. The chain is: R_PICK goes to the cell (0.3 s and InPos); R_FORK_OUT extends the fork to the right until AtRight; R_RAISE raises it until Raised; R_LIFTED waits 0.3 s; R_RETRACT retracts the fork until Centre; R_TO_DOCK goes to Bay 0 and Level 0 (0.3 s and InPos); R_DOCK_OUT extends the fork to the right until AtRight; R_UNLOAD runs BeltRight until NOT Loaded; R_CLEAR waits 0.8 s; R_BACK retracts the fork until Centre; R_FINISH waits 0.5 s and, in a P1 action, clears Held and Want of the cell and adds 1 to Served.

faultCases: The starting project stores boxes, but a request is never served: the box stays in its cell, no box reaches the outfeed bin and Green never lights.
